summary: Controller shows only VPC instances with an Elastic IP by default; set `vpc_destination_variable: private_ip_address` in the Amazon EC2 inventory source variables and resync (controller must run inside the VPC).
questions: EC2 private instances not showing in inventory
How do I use private IPs in the EC2 inventory source?

answer_card.title: Show private EC2 VPC instances
answer_card.answer_md:
Inventory > Amazon EC2 source > *Source Variables*:
```yaml
vpc_destination_variable: private_ip_address
```
Save and sync. Controller must run inside the VPC with access to those addresses.
